auth.why: To act on the user's tenancy: manage their final-paycheck cases, generate demand letters, and collect the 25% contingency fee via Stripe.

description: Recovers unpaid final wages. Watches for job changes, diaries each state's legal deadline, drafts the statute-citing demand letter once overdue, and charges 25% only on user-confirmed recoveries.

proactive_triggers.description: Job separation email or final-pay dispute detected
proactive_triggers.event: user appears to have left a job with unpaid wages

tools.description: Current status: deadline, days remaining/overdue, statute, billing state
tools.name: get_case_status
confirm_case
tools.description: One-tap activation of a draft case created from a job_change life event
Generate the statute-citing demand letter PDF (only once the deadline has passed; never sent by the service — user sends it)
tools.name: generate_demand_letter

tools.description: Look up a state's final-paycheck deadline rule, statute, and penalty note
tools.name: get_state_law

tools.description: Set up Stripe billing: customer + card SetupIntent for the later 25% contingency charge
tools.name: setup_billing

tools.description: User confirms wages recovered; charge the 25% contingency fee off-session
tools.name: confirm_recovery

webhooks.case_deadline_passed: Fired when a tracked case's legal deadline passes; agent generates the demand letter PDF for user approval.
